title: Terminated employee's account still enabled
condition: rpatel left on 2026-09-30 and was still enabled on 2026-11-17, 48 days later. Leaver ticket HR-1057 was never actioned.
root_cause: Leaver tickets go to a shared queue with no SLA, and the HR leaver list is never reconciled against active accounts.
risk: A former employee keeps working credentials with access to finance systems and AP data.
recommendation: Disable rpatel and review their sign-ins since 2026-09-30. Put a same-day SLA on leaver tickets and reconcile the HR leaver list against enabled accounts weekly.

title: Unowned global admin without MFA and excess standing role
condition: tempadmin held standing Global Administrator with no owner and no MFA method. jwalsh (IT Support Analyst) still held User Administrator from a migration.
root_cause: Setup accounts are not decommissioned after use, and the monthly privileged role review is not being performed.
risk: One password could compromise the whole tenant, and an IT support account can reset credentials for any user.
recommendation: Disable tempadmin and remove its Global Administrator role. Remove User Administrator from jwalsh and give password reset duties through an eligible Helpdesk Administrator role in PIM. Enforce MFA for admin roles with Conditional Access.

title: Access review late and not independent
condition: The Q3 review was signed off 5 to 6 days after the 2026-10-15 due date. dmoreau and labadmin approved their own access, and rpatel's access was kept after they left.
root_cause: The review steps allow self-review and the review list is not reconciled against the HR leaver list.
risk: Unneeded access, including a leaver's, is approved and carried into the next quarter.
recommendation: Have managers and admins reviewed by someone other than themselves, reconcile against the HR leaver list before the review goes out and track the due date.

title: P1 vulnerabilities past SLA or missing due dates
condition: 2 of 11 P1 tickets were open past the 7 day SLA (VULN-4 by 19 days, VULN-3 open for 26 days). VULN-1, VULN-2 and VULN-3 had no due date.
root_cause: Early tickets were created outside the normal flow, before due dates were enforced, and nothing reports on overdue tickets.
risk: Critical vulnerabilities on an internet facing system stay open past the accepted risk window.
recommendation: Remediate or formally close VULN-3 and VULN-4. Make due date required on P1 and P2 tickets and send a weekly overdue report to the owners.

title: Changes reach main without review
condition: 0 of 40 sampled commits came through a pull request and no repository has branch protection.
root_cause: Each repository has a single maintainer, so there is no second reviewer, and branch protection was never turned on.
risk: A defective or unauthorized change can be released without anyone else seeing it.
recommendation: Turn on branch protection for main requiring a pull request. Where there is only one maintainer, have a second person review the month's changes and record it.

title: Security checks run on one repository only
condition: 3 of 4 repositories have no CI checks, and Dependabot security updates were off on all four.
root_cause: The CI workflow was built for cve-triage and never rolled out to the other repositories.
risk: Vulnerable dependencies or insecure code can be released unnoticed.
recommendation: Turn on Dependabot security updates for all four repositories and copy the cve-triage workflow to the others.

title: No evidence of alert review
condition: The detection searches exist, but there is no record that alerts were reviewed or what was decided.
root_cause: The daily review is not written into a procedure with a place to record it.
risk: An alert can be missed and the control can't be shown to have operated.
recommendation: Record each review (date, analyst, alerts seen, action) in a ticket or log, with a weekly sign-off.
